analysis_summaries: SPECTRA reconstructs 3D geometry from a video by sampling two frames approximately one second apart. It RGB-preprocesses and pads each frame to 518×518, then packs them into the fixed-size FP32 atlas required by VGGT. The VGGT ONNX model produces camera-pose encodings, depth, and depth-confidence maps; the decoder recovers poses and unprojects depth into a filtered point cloud. The pipeline writes a PLY cloud along with reconstruction metadata and a geometry-ready event.

info.user_prompt:
SPECTRA: VGGT-only 3D geometric mapping from video. Custom model, do NOT use a catalog pipeline or substitute any detector/depth model.

Model: my own ONNX at /home/atharv/spectra/model/vggt.onnx (VGGT-1B, opset 18, external weights in vggt.onnx.data in the same folder - keep them together). Source repo: /home/atharv/spectra/repo.
Input tensor: "images" FP32 NCHW [1,3,518,1036], values 0-1, no extra normalization (VGGT normalizes internally).
Outputs (raw tensors, no bbox parser): "pose_enc" [1,2,9], "depth" [1,2,518,518], "depth_conf" [1,2,518,518]. DeepStream: network-type=100, output-tensor-meta=1.

Pipeline: video file decode (/home/atharv/spectra/input/kitchen-sample.mp4) -> sample 2 frames ~1 s apart -> VGGT pad-preprocess each to 518x518 RGB -> pack side by side into a 1036x518 atlas -> TensorRT inference -> extract raw tensors -> decode camera poses + unproject depth into 3D points (spectra/deployment/contract.py) -> Open3D confidence/outlier filtering -> sinks: PLY point cloud + JSON event "geometry_ready" (action inspect_reconstruction, point count, PLY path, hashes).

Target GPU: RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB. FP32 weights are 4.6 GB so build TensorRT in FP16 compute with FP32 inputs/outputs. Report unsupported ops or out-of-memory errorary, never metres.

evidence: Most of the picture changes from one frame to the next (91% of areas), so the camera moves.
